name: brain
description: Persistent, neuroscience-inspired memory for Codex. A SessionStart hook injects a budget-bounded context payload from the user's ~/.brain; the brain-memory skill teaches deterministic recall and provenance-stamped memorization via the brain CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory your agent can explain
interface.longDescription: One human-readable ~/.brain shared across Codex, Claude Code and other agents. Every memory carries provenance (origin, trust weighting, quarantine until verified) and a validity window; recall is deterministic with spreading activation and visible receipts. Requires the brain CLI (npm i -g brain-memory) for the skill; the session-start hook runs from the plugin itself.
